title: Pawn chains
line: Pawns guarding each other on a diagonal. Attack the base of the chain.

steps.text: White's pawns on d4 and e5 form a chain: each guards the one ahead of it on the diagonal. Black's pawns form one too.
The front pawn is guarded. The pawn at the back, the base, has no pawn to guard it. Tap the base of White's chain.

wrong.e5: That is the front of the chain. The pawn behind it guards it.

steps.hint: Follow the chain back toward White's side.
steps.after: Take the base away and the front pawn has no guard.

steps.text: Hit the base with a pawn: push the pawn on c7 two squares. A pawn move that attacks an enemy pawn like this is a pawn break.
steps.after: White guards d4 with a pawn on c3, which is now the base of a longer chain.

steps.text: Bring a knight out to hit the pawn on d4 again.
Now the queen. Bring her out to join the attack on d4.
steps.after: A pawn, a knight and the queen hit d4. White has to keep guarding it.

summary: A pawn chain is only as strong as its base. Attack the base with a pawn, then bring pieces to it.
